objective: reduce one four-scene outer attempt from 60-70 minutes toward 45 minutes without changing formal measurements or convergence

optimized_reset.old_behavior: authenticated normal shutdown could spend 120 seconds in docker wait and another 120 seconds in docker stop on an old datadir that is always quarantined
optimized_reset.new_behavior: after client drain set innodb_fast_shutdown=2 on the discard-only predecessor, wait at most 30 seconds, then use audited SIGKILL only if it still has not exited; preserve an identity-verified stopped wrapper, replace its bind-source runtime with a sealed-template copy, restart it, and restore innodb_fast_shutdown=1
optimized_reset.stopped_wrapper_reuse: required when the exact predecessor container survives shutdown; a removed wrapper falls back to a fresh docker run
optimized_reset.discard_only_blkio_throttle_lift: remove old-container target-device read/write throttle after workload drain and restore frozen caps on the new measurement container

optimized_plan_ranking.old_behavior: four independent scene rankings executed serially
optimized_plan_ranking.new_behavior: four independent scene rankings execute concurrently on distinct representative workers

historical_runtime_basis_seconds.optimized_v2_reset_bottleneck: four transient bootstrap containers all required docker-stop fallback; slowest workers spent approximately 93-95 seconds in bootstrap shutdown alone
historical_runtime_basis_seconds.optimized_v3_reset_bottleneck: discard shutdown reached 285.9 seconds on xp_io_w1 after docker wait timeout and docker stop fallback

target_runtime_seconds.target_description: approximately 45 minutes from two observed passing batches plus a 600-second single-candidate batch and the validated 104-second partial reset

successor_reason: admit only exact frozen-port TPC-H BenchBase thin drivers under a quantitative 10-process, 256MiB each, 0.5-total-core ceiling; server backends remain pinned, all exceedances fail closed, and no external process is changed
